page.content:
Once and future king of the Britons, lord of Camelot.

How King Arthur connects

  • Location: Camelot — Arthur holds court at Camelot.
  • Event: Battle of Camlann — Arthur receives his mortal wound at Camlann.
  • Faction: Round Table — Arthur is the head of the Round Table fellowship.
  • Character: Uther Pendragon — Uther Pendragon is Arthur's father.
  • Weapon: Excalibur — Arthur wields Excalibur as the sword of his reign.
  • Character: Mordred — Mordred usurps Arthur and faces him at Camlann.
  • Character: Merlin — Merlin arranged Arthur's birth and rise to the sword.
  • Character: Guinevere — Guinevere is Arthur's queen and lady of Camelot.
  • Location: Avalon — The wounded Arthur is taken to Avalon.
  • Concept: Pendragon — Arthur inherits the Pendragon claim.
  • Character: Morgan le Fay — Morgan plots against Arthur even as she later bears him to Avalon.

What is King Arthur?

Arthur draws the sword, founds the fellowship, wages the Roman and Saxon wars of the chronicles, and falls to Mordred at Camlann. His return from Avalon is the legend's open ending.

Key threads lead to Camelot, Battle of Camlann, Round Table, Uther Pendragon, Excalibur and Mordred.
